        cases h₅₁₄ with
        | inl h₅₁₅ =>

        | inr h₅₁₅ =>
          contradiction

      have h₆₉₁ : (a % 7 = 1 ∧ b % 7 = 2) ∨ (a % 7 = 1 ∧ b % 7 = 4) ∨ (a % 7 = 2 ∧ b % 7 = 1) ∨ (a % 7 = 2 ∧ b % 7 = 4) ∨ (a % 7 = 3 ∧ b % 7 = 2) ∨ (a % 7 = 3 ∧ b % 7 = 5) ∨ (a % 7 = 4 ∧ b % 7 = 1) ∨ (a % 7 = 4 ∧ b % 7 = 5) ∨ (a % 7 = 5 ∧ b % 7 = 3) ∨ (a % 7 = 5 ∧ b % 7 = 4) ∨ (a % 7 = 6 ∧ b % 7 = 1) ∨ (a % 7 = 6 ∧ b % 7 = 2) ∨ (a % 7 = 6 ∧ b % 7 = 4) := by
